def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = grid[0][0]
    active = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v != bg for v in row)]
    # Lower pattern block aligns row-by-row with upper pattern block. Only
    # recolor trailing background cells where the corresponding upper row has
    # foreground; interior differences are part of the pattern, not omissions.
    half = len(active) // 2
    if half:
        for upper, lower in zip(active[:half], active[half:]):
            c = len(grid[0]) - 1
            while c >= 0 and grid[lower][c] == bg:
                if grid[upper][c] != bg:
                    out[lower][c] = 1
                c -= 1
    return out
